'''Wire-guided relays''' were used in [[Prax Arms/Legends|Prax Arms']] [[HB-4 Projectile Rifle]]. Each [[mini-missile]] projectile fired by the weapon was guided to the target by the relays using a [[mono-filament trace-wire]].
